cards.card_text: The LORD also says Satan incited Him against Job "to ruin him without cause." Satan fires right back, "Skin for skin!" like a guy who just lost the argument and is ALREADY asking for a rematch.
cards.verse_text: Then the LORD said to Satan, “Have you considered My servant Job? For there is no one on earth like him, a man who is blameless and upright, who fears God and shuns evil. He still retains his integrity, even though you incited Me against him to ruin him without cause.” “Skin for skin!” Satan replied. “A man will give up all he owns in exchange for his life.
